name: DC regression: SSL 82E10 dynamics servo (snapshot of the wave-e WIP netlist, ENGINE_QUEUE item 29)
description: Frozen snapshot of work/circuit-netlists/wave-e/ssl-4000e-dynamics-133000.circuit.json as of the ENGINE_QUEUE item 29 report (2026-11-10, before its servo was reworked), kept as the DC regression for gmin stepping: one 53-unknown group holding the dbx 2151-class VCA, the AD536 side-chain, the attack/release integrator and the CV servo, where the direct and source-stepped Newton fail. Card 82E10 DYNAMICS SECTION (drawing T82010.71) of the SSL 611E channel module, from the 4000G service manual page 35. Audio in (card pin 60) through 2u2 + 20K0 into a dbx 2151 Blackmer VCA, out of an NE5534 I/V converter with a 20K feedback, then two 220 uF/25 V coupling capacitors to the AUDIO OUT (pin 61) with R83 1M polarising the midpoint. The side-chain taps that output node through R85 10K into an AD536AJ rms-to-DC converter in the datasheet's dB connection (side-chain input on card pin 25), whose dB output (3 mV/dB) drives a x32.9 amplifier trimmed to the card's printed law 10 dB = 1 V (TP1), then an inverter/0 dBm trim (TP2); a 1M/1M attack-release integrator with the COMPRESS THRESHOLD injection, the RELEASE and ATTACK panel controls and the FAST/AUTO release resistors, a unity-gain buffer, the COMPRESS RATIO divider, and the T4 ratio-law shaper (a diode network on its feedback: R56 5K1 + R88 56K to 0 V with D14/D19, R55 100K to the D27/T4b/R94 shaping node, and D20 from the control node) driving TR1, an emitter follower that drives the VCA's control pin. A 5534 servo (T8) with 1K/1n around the control node closes the loop.

sources.title: Solid State Logic SL4000G Console Service Manual, card 82E10 'Dynamics Section', drawing T82010.71, 611E/V sheet 1 of 1, PDF page 35
Solid State Logic SL4000G Console Service Manual, 'Component Pin Out' sheet drawing T500A: the DBX2151 VCA symbol, pins IN, VC+, VC-, SYM, V-, GND, V+, OUT (real text layer)
Analog Devices AD536A rms-to-DC converter datasheet rev. G: pin functions, dB output 3 mV/dB, Fig. 6 (R1 25k averaging, R4 50k input), Fig. 7 (dB connection, +100 mV/dB amplifier)
Headroom CIRCUIT_ENGINE.md 10.17: the ad536 part and its model (input 16.67k to COM behind R4 50k, CAV averaging at 25 ms/uF, dB = COM - 3 mV/dB x 20 log10(I3/IREF), IREF 20 uA = 0 dB at 1 V rms)

NE5534.note: TI NE5534 datasheet: AVD 100 V/mV, GBW 10 MHz, slew 13 V/us. The library has no 5534 card; the 22 pF compensation (CT on 82E13, C21 here) is not representable on the 5-node opamp card, its effect is carried by gbw/slew.

ZENER_1V4.note: 1 V4 5% zener (D1), the card's side-chain reference. No published datasheet for a 1.4 V zener: bv 1.4 V at 5 mA with nbv 2 to keep the breakdown knee outside the forward region (CIRCUIT_ENGINE 10.15). At the card's ~0.6 mA it sits near 1.34 V.

controls.label: Ratio
controls.note: COMPRESS RATIO 10K LIN. DUAL (section A). Its track runs from 0 V to the filtered side-chain demand (T2D buffer through R26 100R + R27 2K7); the wiper feeds T4c's + input (card pins 10 = wiper, 11 = track top). 0 = 1:1, 1 = the full demand, i.e. the maximum ratio.

controls.label: Threshold
controls.note: COMPRESS THRESHOLD 10K LIN. DUAL (section A): top to +5 V, bottom through R16 4K7 to 0 V, wiper on card pin 15 into R15 1M2 at the attack/release integrator's summing node.

controls.label: Attack
controls.note: ATTACK 10K LIN. DUAL (card pin 21), a rheostat between the integrator's output (T2C pin 7) and the timing node C5 3u3. The panel pot is drawn through the harness, so the card carries it on pin 21.

controls.label: Release
controls.note: RELEASE 250K LOG (card pin 20 = one end, pin 23 '0V RELEASE' = the wiper, returned to 0 V): a rheostat from the R22 10K node to 0 V. LOG taper.

controls.label: Release type (FAST/AUTO)
controls.note: The panel FAST/AUTO release switch (card pins 19 = FAST, 22 = AUTO): selects R19 300R (fast) or R21 10K (auto) into the release node. 0 = FAST, 1 = AUTO.

controls.label: Fast attack
controls.note: unverified: the 82E08 Dynamics Switch card carries a FAST ATTACK switch (SOURCES-and-BLOCKERS.md section 2); its contacts are not on the 82E10 drawing. Modelled as a short across the ATTACK rheostat, the only point where a fast-attack switch can act on this card.

controls.label: VCA symmetry (VR4)
controls.note: VR4 50K ADJUST SYM across +-15 V, wiper through R74 33K to the 2151 SYM pin, with R25 51R from SYM to 0 V.

controls.label: dB law set (VR1 200R)
controls.note: VR1 200R SET GAIN, a rheostat in series with R6 910R: 3 mV/dB x 36K5/(910+VR1) = 100 mV/dB at VR1 = 185 ohm, the card's printed 10 dB = 1 V at TP1. Default = full 200 ohm (1.11k), the value the AD536 validation circuit uses.

controls.label: 0 dBm set (VR2 5K0)
controls.note: VR2 5K0 SET 0dBm, a rheostat from R9 8K2 (fed by the D1 1V4 reference through R5 2K2) into T2B's summing node: the DC (0 dB) level at TP2.

controls.label: Knee
controls.note: no knee control exists on either 82E10 or 82E13: the knee is the fixed diode network D14/D19 + R88 56K + R56 5K1 on T4c's feedback, and D27/R94/T4b feeding the R55 100K node. Stored only.

controls.label: Output
controls.note: the card has no output-level control: AUDIO OUT (pin 61) leaves through R84 10R, and the channel level is the fader on 82E13. Stored only.

controls.label: Link
controls.note: SW2B LINK couples this channel's shaping node (Z, the D27/R55/D20 junction) into the inter-channel bus through C1 0.1 uF; the bus side is the Total-Recall/multiplex interface (MPX, SW2A, R23 'ON 611', the +11 V rail), which is console housekeeping and not netlisted. A single channel runs with the link open, which is what this netlist models.

controls.label: Side-chain source
controls.note: the internal tap (R85 10K from the output node) and the SIDE CHAIN INPUT connector (card pin 25) are summed permanently on the drawing; there is no source-select switch on either card. Stored only.

controls.label: Wet
controls.note: a console channel card has no wet/dry mix. Stored only.

controls.label: Compressor meter
controls.note: the card's LED bargraph (T5/T6/T7 CA3130 comparators with LED pairs 58/59, 56/57, 54/55, 52/53, 50/51 marked 3/6/10/14/20 dB and 3K0 droppers) is display only, not audio. Stored only.

controls.label: Gate meter
controls.note: as the compressor meter: display only.

controls.label: Gate range
controls.note: the gate/expander half of 82E10 (VR3 SET GATE, R31 510K, R30/R34 36K, D8/D9, T3/T4 CA3130, the 250K LIN RANGE and RELEASE pots) is not netlisted yet; the drawing is read at value level only. Stored only.

controls.label: Gate threshold
controls.note: as gateRange.

controls.label: Gate mode
controls.note: as gateRange.

controls.label: Gate fast attack
controls.note: as gateRange.

controls.label: Gate release
controls.note: as gateRange.

controls.label: Boost
controls.note: not on either card. Stored only.

controls.label: On/Off
controls.note: console-driven. Stored only.

T8 5534, the control servo. Its inverting input is the VCA's control node (R86 1K0 in parallel with C30 1n0 and C21 22p as feedback, as drawn); its non-inverting input takes the ratio-scaled demand. INFERRED: the drawing shows this input ending on a 0 V tick at 2.8-4.8 px/source-px, but a servo held at 0 V can never move the VCA's control pin, so the demand is the only reading that makes the node a control node at all. See notes 7a.

asterisked. The servo's feedback resistor, as drawn (the control node to T8's output), in parallel with C30 and C21. This is the DC feedback that makes the servo a transimpedance stage rather than a drifting integrator.
